Current queue review,20October2026 (bd-01M5E33RPWBT8NAGKCKJMMN6FN)

Completeness: incomplete_container.
Assessment: Engineering release and scientific efficacy remain separate; historical completed journeys stay completed.
Staleness: Container next-action list predates reviewed unmerged S1/mapping work.
Remaining / next action: Track the selected bounded tranche, then remaining Native/release acceptance; claim children rather than this epic.
Audit: docs/refactor/evidence/queue-review-20261020/README.md. This planning review does not grant publication, study-read or integration authority.

--- Preserved prior scope, acceptance and history ---

Current follow-through (reality-check-20261015)

The owner approved the four reality-check workstreams with grakern pinned to GitHub. The complete decision/acceptance packet is this issue's 15 October decision note, tagged reality-check-20261015. Execute S1 bd-01M50K8E8KMRGY0MYXJRT0SZ8G first; U1 bd-01M50K95JAQB34R876FWMV85J0 and E1 bd-01M50KBFT26DRB77VFHPRHYNA2 can progress independently. Native bd-01M4YP83C7925M22V0K5AQ88BX, own-study U3 bd-01M50KAP8CB5MMBQE3BX4RQ2PF and the existing release gate retain their distinct acceptance. Research remains independent of software release. The reviewed ordinary-file/imaging/docs/Atlas journey and constructor repairs are complete; do not restart them. Claim a bounded child, not this container.

--- Retained prior scope and acceptance; current disposition above supersedes stale next-action prose ---

Current release queue, 7 October 2026: release-1.0; milestone-delivery.
Plan: docs/refactor/RELEASE-QUEUE.md. Mote remains authoritative; one primary agent and at most one helper.

Reconciliation: Recovery, approved-host handoff, eligibility and strict S2a-3 are landed. Organization and compiled-film delivery are explicitly 1.1; research is later.

Remaining / next action: Container: select the next bounded child from RELEASE-QUEUE.md; do not claim the whole epic. Deliver ordinary-file text/Atlas first, then Sherlock and weighted temporal/video/imaging paths; final 1.0 release remains separate.

Release tags schedule work; they do not establish completion or empirical qualification. Use current AGENTS.md for ownership, scoped gates and exact-SHA review; old fleet roles, timers and fixed gate task counts are historical. Keep the original scientific preregistration, denominators, admission and sealed-test rules below.

Retained acceptance and design context:

Scheduling lane: container. Current plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md. Live dependency edges supersede historical sequencing below.

Governing plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md (2026-09-19); ADR 0019. Key: epic; lane: container.

Scope: docs/refactor/PLAN.md, BACKLOG.md

Acceptance criteria:
1. G0-G2 public annotation-assisted preview demonstrated with complete accounting, reference/reconstruction policies, compatibility and downstream reader.
2. [Revised 2026-09-22] Film compiler (G4 compiled-film API, D1B end-to-end proofs, V1, E0) is 1.1 (container bd-01M35MK5N6F0EWJE2EYT3D8Y9M); organization analyses (compatibility, counts, synthetic recovery) are 1.1 (container bd-01M35P2EKWC52PZTMN2R5NMDFR). 1.0 closes on the release gate bd-01M2TAMJ95K9D7H248A8387YW4.
3. Release gate closes on execution/structural/API evidence. Scientific recovery, calibrated confidence and superiority are distinct named claim gates; no optional provider or research win gates engineering.
4. Every unfinished issue has a lane and remaining-work statement; only executable prerequisites use dep; no stale fleet authority. Gate review identifies one next failing witness.

Validation: Mote graph/crosswalk checks and exact-SHA gate receipts

Completion evidence: exact baseline/result SHA, executable command and bound test totals/exit, artifact digests, discriminating failure injection, compatibility impact, separate SD6 review. Run reference-scope for the actual diff and SD2 checkAll before landing. Proposed suite names below are acceptance specifications, not existing or executed tests. No efficacy claim follows from a synthetic pass.

Boundary: Contains work with rel, not a dependency on every child.

2026-09-22 operative workflow reconciliation (docs/plans/2026-09-22-recall-encoding-workflow.md):
The reusable recall-to-encoding workflow is implemented through the existing evidence, inference, timing, facade and exchange tickets plus bounded temporal-query, OpenNeuro raw/BIDS scanner-crosswalk and optional fine-localization follow-ons. StoryAtlas owns the interactive temporal consumer in its own store. M1's fixed-cut workspace and active G1 revision 3 retain their current acceptance boundaries. Basic mapping exchange and temporal localization can ship without organization tables; full G2 preview still requires compatibility, organization, transition exchange and synthetic recovery. Calibration and a benchmark win are separate claim gates. Exact IDs and the applied migration receipt are indexed in docs/refactor/BACKLOG.md.
